name: チーム外ユーザーの直接アクセス権行
prompt:
Recreate only the Dropbox external-access row shown in the primary original crop. Match its shallow 553:66 aspect ratio (about 8.4:1); do not add top or bottom blank bands, a dialog, or surrounding page. The original source controls the geometry. No Japanese mock exists for this source.

On a plain white row, place a 40 px purple circular avatar with a white “S” at the far left. Immediately to its right, show the exact email “samlee@content-mobbin.com” in dark gray on the first line, and 「Dropbox チーム外」 in smaller muted gray directly below. At the far right, vertically center the permission control 「閲覧可能」 with a small downward gray triangle. Keep the large open horizontal gap between the identity block and permission selector. Preserve the source text size hierarchy, alignment, whitespace and colors. Do not add a border, card, extra buttons, or any other text.
reviewNotes: LH09-0260 v001 compared with the assigned 553x66 Dropbox direct-access row. It preserves the exact email, S avatar, external-team subline and view-permission selector in the correct left/right arrangement. Major geometry defect: the generated image is 1986x792 (2.51:1), leaving broad blank bands; after proportional width normalization, the row content is about 44 px tall versus the 66 px source crop. Similar narrow-strip generations have returned oversized fixed canvases, so one attempt was used. Status: needs-correction; image-generation review only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
